q: 1. Fiscal policy of government relates to ---------
options: Policies regarding interest rate, credit margins and money supply
Policies regarding financial institutions and bank
explain: Fiscal policy specifically deals with government revenue (taxation) and spending (budgeting), whereas money supply and interest rates fall under Monetary Policy.

q: 2. Numerous issues can be addressed by ____ including crime, education, monetary policy, foreign policy.
explain: Public policy is the instrument used to address various societal challenges across all these different sectors.
